items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to antidepressant drug treatments, cognitive behavioural therapy, the Wiles CBT effectiveness study, and the reductionist vs holistic debate.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: BBC Radio 4's mental health programme includes episodes on CBT effectiveness, the debate around antidepressants, and the future of depression treatment.

items.title: What is CBT? | Making Sense of Cognitive Behavioural Therapy — Sprouts
items.description: Clear, well-paced explainer of how CBT works in practice — covers the cognitive model, thought challenging, and behavioural activation, all relevant to the AQA spec.

items.title: Depressive and Bipolar Disorders: Crash Course Psychology #30
items.description: Crash Course episode that includes coverage of how depression is treated, providing context for evaluating drug vs psychological therapies.

items.title: Good Will Hunting (1997)
items.description: Drama in which a young man reluctantly engages with a therapist — a nuanced portrayal of the therapeutic relationship and how talk therapy can address psychological barriers that medication alone cannot.

items.title: Inside Out 2 (2024) — Official Trailer
items.description: The sequel to Inside Out introduces anxiety alongside the original emotions — a useful cultural reference point for discussing why emotional regulation and therapy matter.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Cognitive Behavioural Therapy
items.description: Revision resource covering how CBT works, its evidence base, strengths and limitations — matches the AQA spec requirements for evaluating therapies.

items.title: YoungMinds — Depression
items.description: Plain-English guide to depression treatment options for young people — useful for understanding what CBT and medication look like in practice beyond the textbook.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology specification
items.description: Official spec — confirms exactly what you need to know about Wiles' study and the reductionism vs holism debate for Psychological Problems.
